items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I've got here Bob Dorsey and Greely Walton. Yeah, that's it. That's right. They was the other two.

ctx.x: Well, when we were sitting all next one another... Let me see, Lee Polk was on one side of me, Eddie was on the other side of me, and I'm in the middle between them two, and then there's two more saxophones -- we had five saxophones.
I've got here Bob Dorsey and Greely Walton.
Yeah, that's it. That's right. They was the other two.
